items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: The real catalyst on this recording is Billy Higgins.

ctx.x: Yeah. The original “Freedom Jazz Dance.” Boy there’s so many things we could talk about. What I usually point out to people, and particularly my students when I usually bring a recording of this in, because most young students when they learn “Freedom Jazz Dance” they learn Miles’ version of it. And they’ve never heard this version, the original, and what it’s really about. The real catalyst on this recording is Billy Higgins. Because you hear the whole tradition of black music in his playing on this, from New…
That one I’m not aware of.
